shop._help: CHECKOUT SETUP: paste a Stripe Payment Link (https://buy.stripe.com/...) for each product, and/or the email address of your PayPal Business account. Leave blank to hide that button. If both are blank, the product page shows an 'Order by email' button instead.

contact_form._help: Optional. Paste a form endpoint (e.g. https://formspree.io/f/xxxx) to show an enquiry form on the Contact page. Leave blank to show phone/email only.
